video.content: Neurological assessment at referral: right upper limb dystonic posturing with excessive wrist extension and finger hyperextension while opening a screw-cap bottle.
video.format: H.264, 738x592, 30 fps, no audio. Face out of frame; patient seated, right hand opening a screw-cap bottle held in the left hand.

annotations.label: Right hand grips the cap with the wrist held in extension; index finger lifts off the cap
Right hand releases abruptly from the cap with wrist extension and all fingers hyperextended and splayed
Re-grasps the cap; wrist extension persists
Second abrupt release with finger hyperextension
Repeated attempts to grip and turn the cap; left hand holding the bottle shows no abnormal posture

note: Agent-visible clip only. Any further media for this case is held out under cases/reference/media/ (see the reference file). Timestamps from frame review at 0.5 s resolution on 2026-10-17 (not physician-reviewed); Wiki to confirm labels.
